elements.name: Keep compact ribbon display when switching document types

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` and `fixtures/cad/blank-drawing.odd` are open in the MCAD Software
a drawing and a part are open in the MCAD Software
the drawing is active with its ribbon in compact group-button mode
the user activates the part document
the part ribbon displays its command groups as compact buttons
those buttons include Sketch, Create and Modify
the user returns to the drawing document
its ribbon displays compact Create, Modify, Sketch and Sheets group buttons
